step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture displays how Amazon EKS cluster telemetry (logs, metrics, distributed traces) is collected using various daemonsets and sidecars (AppOptics, Prometheus, Fluentd), aggregated via CloudWatch and exported to centralized dashboards (AppOptics, Loggly, PaperTrail). Nodes are identified based on visual representations and audio descriptions, using standard AWS services and ThirdParty designations. Edges capture the data flows from agents and CloudWatch into the centralized monitoring platforms.
